consumerCopy.requirement: Byte-identical copy of every populated set, compared by make protocol-compat.

sets.name: auth
sets.purpose: Client certificate profile, RFC 9440 header profile, authentication and credential-rotation proof vectors, surface separation, and the frozen error reason registry.

sets.name: version
sets.purpose: Protocol version negotiation decisions, the frozen v1 negotiation field registry, and additive compatibility in both skew directions.

sets.name: registration
sets.purpose: Registration token exchange, proof of possession, replay rejection, and certificate issuance.

sets.name: heartbeat
sets.purpose: Heartbeat payloads, Connect receive time, and freshness window behavior.

sets.name: inventory
sets.purpose: Inventory snapshot payloads and their allow-listed collection fields.

sets.name: offline-enrollment
sets.purpose: Air-gapped device enrolment and signed artifact exchange without a certificate.

sets.name: bundle
sets.purpose: Support bundle manifests, upload authorization, and archive validation.

sets.name: redaction
sets.purpose: Deterministic redaction of telemetry and support bundle content.
